libs.note: BH-4658 (BH-4656 part 1). The shared on-disk PR snapshot under state/pr-snapshot/<owner_repo>/: the open-PR list, the base tip and per-PR bodies keyed on (number, head, updated_at, base tip). Applied by pr-snapshot.sh itself at file scope, in a subshell, the same way gh-budget.sh does, so a fail-closed exit never stops the lane that sourced it. First consumer: bin/lead-review-enqueue.sh.

knobs.note: The kill switch. 0 (or empty, or not a number) = every prs_* function calls GitHub straight through and nothing under state/pr-snapshot is read or written.
How long the cached open-PR list and base tip are trusted. 0 = no cache at all: the open list, the base tip and the per-PR store are all read live and nothing is stored.

The open-list TTL used instead of PR_SNAPSHOT_TTL_S when prs_wake_seen says no wake arrived for the repo since the list was cached (rc 1). Until the BH-4656 wakes sibling lands, prs_wake_seen answers 2 and this is never used.
Read by the BH-4656 wakes sibling (bin/lib/pr-snapshot-wakes.sh) through this lib's resolution: how old the wake feed may be before it is not trusted. Resolved here, acted on by nothing in BH-4658.
